description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moragollagama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420911
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land settlement and title registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
